method: Read-only decomposition of sanitized official actions. Movement = Euclidean distance / 5 m/s; measure = 5 s plus 1 s only when measurement channel changes (initial channel 1); clear = 5 s on success else 3 s. Tail begins after last successful clear. Posthoc empty-channel attribution uses user-confirmed full-clear source totals solely for diagnosis; unavailable to policy. Known-source movement attribution uses only earlier positive protocol observations. Stops with >=3 measures are a descriptive stationary-sweep proxy, not a recovered strategy-internal action classification.

slow_run_comparison.description: Symmetric arithmetic decomposition of T/N for the 11-source run versus the mean of the two 15-source runs; explanatory accounting, not a causal counterfactual or proof that source-count alone caused the difference.

findings: The 11-source slow run sees only 2 sources in the origin sweep, versus 12 and 8 in the two 15-source runs. The layouts therefore also differ in how early sources become visible; source count is not the only confounder.
The 11-source slow run performs no failed clear and no operations after its final successful clear. A terminal-tail cutoff cannot fix this run.
All three runs measure every finally empty channel exactly 8 times. Reducing geometrically certified coverage stations or their travel is a stronger target than weakening the no-source decision.

Known-source movement totals are similar despite source counts (1333.64, 1256.46, 1406.38 seconds), while travel to measurements of then-unknown channels rises to 982.51 seconds in the slow run (versus 618.63 and 797.87). Action labels are an observational proxy for policy intent.

The 11-source run needs 951.16 total seconds saved to individually reach 200 seconds/source. The pooled three-run screenshot aggregate needs 369.50 total seconds saved, but these three official practice cases do not establish the independent average.

Do not read the official post-run source total in the strategy and do not terminate unknown-channel search merely because 10 or 11 sources have cleared. Public maximum 16 remains a valid existing stop gate.

Suggested search experiment: continuously shorten coverage-station positions within intersections of guaranteed-detection disks around their assigned feasible-grid cells, preserving all originally covered cells. Evaluate jointly with homing changes on paired cases.
